integrity: Every theorem claim is proved analytically in RESULT.md; attached exhaustive finite code is corroborative only. Prior foundational results and conditional sampling distinctions are identified.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs, strictly positive symmetric edge conductances; no extension to directed or zero-weight networks. The universal constant is not claimed optimal, and outside priority evaluation remains necessary.
title: Sharp-order total-variation approximation for conductance-weighted one-out trees
